location.basis: Mound centre read on the imagery (about 29.5984 N, 75.3923 E): an oval grassed mound of about 250 x 260 m ringed by visitor paths and fields, 30 m east of the published Wikipedia position 29.59833 N, 75.39194 E.

main_system_reason: No system: we found no measurable Harappan line.
notes: The Esri imagery is a Vantor Vivid mosaic from a WorldView-3 scene of 8 May 2023 with real detail to zoom 18 (0.52 m per pixel). The mound is grassed and crossed by paths; the excavations of 1974-77 and 1983-88 are backfilled and no wall, street or fortification line is exposed. A small pale square of about 14 m near the centre of the mound is too short to measure and may be a modern marker or pit. The straight lines around the mound are field boundaries and roads of the surrounding farmland, which is laid out on the regular Haryana land-consolidation grid and has no relation to the Harappan plan. Banawali is not measurable from this imagery.
